video.title: Open Source, Faster Jev is HERE

protocol.status: second independent labeler (B), for the noise floor
protocol.note: Drafted from the transcript alone, without seeing any jevcut output.
protocol.times_from: Whisper small transcript; seconds in the source, so labels survive re-transcription

clips.why: Clear explainer: Leia is a Jev-style System One model that outputs typed classification decisions instead of text, in under ~33 ms. Ending on the sub-33ms point also works.
Hot take: Jev took three years in stealth and an open-weights clone appeared within a week, so decision models won't stay closed. Can end at 'we love that' or after 'run it inside your computer'.

Self-contained explanation of System 1 vs System 2 (Thinking Fast and Slow) and why LLMs are System 2 while Jev/Leia are System 1. Can start at the question or at 'Long story short'; can run on through the System 1 examples to 537.

also_ok.why: Surprising fact that stands up from the words alone: browser-use plus Jev booked a flight search in 7 seconds for about $0.004. It is short and partly narrates an on-screen demo, so accept it but don't insist.

negatives.why: Energetic cold open with numbers (30 decisions/sec, length 140) but it narrates the snake game on screen ('as you can clearly see in here').
'Watch this, it's gonna be so fast': play-by-play of the live flight-booking demo; nothing lands without the video.
Playground demo with a fun hook (is a hamburger a sandwich, 94% vs 6%), but it is read off the screen ('in here') and depends on the visible criteria and JSON.
Reads results off an on-screen email-classification demo (94% confidence, 39 ms, 'three times faster'): numbers without a standalone point.
